service: PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 game downloads and title updates
decision: The repository owner approved classifying all five reviewed PS3/PS4/PS5 download and title-update hosts under game-download.

runtime_observation.reported_activity: The user was downloading a PS5 game.
runtime_observation.method: User-supplied gateway connection screenshot; personal source addresses and proxy-node details are not retained.

admitted_hosts.purpose: PS3 and PSP title-update XML containing package URLs; the exact host also serves other PSN resources such as EULAs.
PS5 application and delta package downloads.
PS5 title-update XML and JSON manifests, PlayGo information packages and chunk checksums.
PS4 title-update XML describing patch downloads; also used for PS Vita update metadata.

public_sources.role: Corroborating hostname list only; it also includes web assets and is not imported as a download allowlist.

boundary.selection: Five manually reviewed exact hosts; no external ruleset or source code is imported.
boundary.unobserved_subdomains: The five additions are exact DOMAIN rules and do not classify arbitrary child hosts.

verification_limits: Domain roles are documented by public tools, with a gateway observation for gst. Direct Sony XML retrieval attempts did not succeed. Direct reachability and download performance after the rule change have not been established; the download group remains user-selectable.
